seo.title: ODDspace — workspace, studios and event space in Vallila
seo.description: ODDspace is a workspace, event space and recording/production studio in Vallila, Helsinki — for working, meeting, exhibitions, talks, events and creative projects.

whatItIs.headline: Workspace, studios, events and community under one roof.
whatItIs.body:
ODDspace is a year-round workspace and event space in Vallila for people working across art, culture, design, media, technology, business and other creative fields. It includes coworking areas, meeting rooms, an event and gallery floor, an auditorium and ODDstudio.

People can work independently, host things and cross paths with others working on very different things. The space is a pilot for something larger, and the people using it help shape what it becomes. That combination of shared space, different disciplines and active participation is what we mean by a co-creative space.

vision.headline: Creative work needs more than moments.
vision.body:
Great things happen in projects, events, commissions and productions. But when they end, people disperse, momentum fades and the next thing often starts from scratch.

ODDspace exists to give creative work somewhere to continue between those moments. A place to return to, keep making, meet people outside your own field and let ideas develop before they have a brief, budget or stage.

The ambition is bigger than providing desks or rooms. It is to build the kind of everyday infrastructure where work, relationships and opportunities can accumulate over time. ODDspace is our first real-world experiment in what that could look like.

items.description: The afterparty ODDfest never had in June. Music and open decks, art installations. Bring your own wine or beer; non-alcoholic beer is on the house. Free, and everyone is welcome.

faq.question: Is the studio included in the membership?
faq.answer: No. ODDstudio is the one space that isn't covered by the €150 / month membership. Members can add full studio access for €100 / month — €250 / month in total, including the ODDspace membership — or book the studio at €20 / hour. Booking the studio by the hour does not require a membership. Full rates, equipment and booking terms are on the ODDstudio page.

faq.question: What is ODDspace?
faq.answer: A workspace and event space in Vallila, Helsinki with coworking areas, meeting rooms, an event/gallery floor, an auditorium and ODDstudio, a creative music studio. People can work independently while the space also makes it easier to share work, ask for input and collaborate when useful.

faq.question: Do I need to be a physical member to be part of ODDspace?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Day-to-day workspace access is a membership product, but ODDspace also has events, projects and collaborations that involve people outside the physical member base.

faq.question: How do I become a member?
faq.answer: Read the membership page — it has the price, what's included, what isn't, and how joining works — then apply from there. Memberships are accepted on a rolling basis as space becomes available during the pilot.

faq.question: What does membership cost?
faq.answer: €150 per month, one flat rate — no tiers.

faq.question: What's included in membership?
faq.answer: Full, 24/7 access to the co-working space, shared facilities and meeting rooms, plus member rates on bookable event spaces.

faq.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
faq.answer: No — it's a flexible monthly membership with no long-term commitment during the pilot phase.

faq.question: Can I visit before joining?
faq.answer: Yes — mention it in your message and we'll set up a time to show you around.

faq.question: Can non-members organise events?
faq.answer: Yes. Renting the gallery or auditorium doesn't require membership — get in touch with what you have in mind.

faq.question: What kinds of events can happen there?
faq.answer: Exhibitions, launches, workshops, talks, screenings, shoots, gatherings, performances and showcases have all happened in the space.

faq.question: What spaces are available?
faq.answer: Co-working space, an event/gallery floor, an auditorium and ODDstudio, a creative music studio.

faq.question: How much does event use cost?
faq.answer: From €300 + VAT for creative organisations and cultural workers, and from €750 + VAT for companies. Every price is open to discussion — the venue page has the full rate card and a calculator that prices your own case.

faq.question: How do I enquire about an event?
faq.answer: Start from the venue page: it covers the rooms, member rates, how booking works and what we confirm per event. You don't need to be a member first.

faq.question: Is ODDspace accessible?
faq.answer: We do not have verified accessibility information for the building to publish yet — step-free access, lifts, accessible toilets and door widths are still being documented, and we would rather say that than reassure you about something we have not measured. If accessibility matters for your visit, email hello@oddfest.co and we will tell you exactly what the space can and cannot do today.
